title: Aaron Glenn on Cade Klubnik: Saw the same moxie, confidence we saw in college

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Glenn on Cade Klubnik: Saw the same moxie, confidence we saw in college
sources.description: Cade Klubnik was not expected to start at quarterback for the Jets in their preseason opener, but Geno Smith's sore ankle led the team to bump the fourth-round pick up a slot against the Buccaneers.
